title: Canonical finite-Tor projection and fixed-left internal Hom
statement: Use the finite-field datum, coefficient field $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$, integer $n\geq1$, finite-type $k$-schemes and four coefficient stages of [def-fix-six-functor-datum]. Let $f:X\to Y$ be a morphism with a chosen compactification $c$, and use the recorded operations at a fixed coefficient stage $s$. Supply the restricted functors and closed presentations $R$ of [det-thm-sf-ctf-stability-adjunctions]. Write $\mathcal C_X,\mathcal C_Y$ for their actual finite-Tor full subcategories, $i_X,i_Y$ for the full inclusions, and $T_X,T_Y$ for the recorded partial derived tensors [def-weil-derived-pullback-tensor-hom]. For $M\in\mathcal C_X$ and $T\in\mathcal C_Y$, let $P^{\mathrm{raw}}_{M,T}$ be the specified compact-support projection component [def-exchange-projection], in the tensor coordinates $T_Y(i_Y Rf_!M,T)\to Rf_!T_X(i_XM,Lf^*T)$. Let $\alpha_M:(M\otimes-);i_X\cong T_X(i_XM,-)$ and $\beta_{Rf_!M}:(Rf_!M\otimes-);i_Y\cong T_Y(i_Y Rf_!M,-)$ be R's tensor comparisons. The raw component is an isomorphism for separated finite-type $f$ by [fix-prop-projection-formula]. Define its restricted isomorphism by transporting it through the same tensor comparisons and full inclusion. Define the restricted forward projection $P_{M,T}:Rf_!M\otimes T\to Rf_!(M\otimes Lf^*T)$ to be the full-inclusion preimage of $\beta_{Rf_!M,T};P^{\mathrm{raw}}_{M,T};Rf_!(\alpha_{M,Lf^*T}^{-1})$. Define $H^X_M$ and $H^Y_K$ for $M\in\mathcal C_X$ and $K\in\mathcal C_Y$ by fixing the first input in the recorded restricted internal Hom: $H^X_M(V)=R\mathcal Hom_X(M,V)$ and $H^Y_K(W)=R\mathcal Hom_Y(K,W)$, on objects and arrows. These definitions use the actual recorded operations and comparisons; no new choice of adjunction or projection is supplied.
